summary: Team Chat Phase 2 (supervised minors) — tested end-to-end via public URL. Backend pytest test_team_chat_phase2.py PASSED against the public backend (invite -> minor join -> 403 pre-approval -> non-guardian 403 -> guardian approve -> 200 supervised=true -> minor posts msg -> owner sees msg (oversight) -> revoke -> 403 again). Frontend chat-access screen for personnel logged in as applereview@cheerplanner.app: chat-manage-access icon in chat header opens /team/chat-access (chat-access-screen renders), lists all 3 seeded athletes (Ava Smith, Bella Jones, Cara Lee) with MINOR tag and Invite buttons (testIDs chat-invite-<roster_id>). Tapping Invite successfully calls POST /api/team/chat/athletes/{roster_id}/invite (verified via GET athletes showing invite_code=3N3DW7 for Ava afterward). Supervised banner logic verified via API: /team/chat/messages returns supervised=true for the linked+approved minor and supervised=false for personnel; the banner (testID chat-supervised-banner reading 'A parent/guardian can see this chat.') is wired to that flag in chat.tsx. Athlete-open-chat button (testID athlete-open-chat) is wired in the Team tab locked screen for chat-approved minors.

ui_bugs.issue: On web (react-native-web), Alert.alert('Invite code', code) does not appear as a browser dialog; RN-web renders it as an in-app modal (not a window.confirm/alert), so users see the code in a custom modal — not a native alert. API call itself works (invite_code is generated server-side). Not a bug, just a note.

Review request expected the row to switch to a parent-approval Switch immediately after tapping Invite. In current implementation the switch only appears once the athlete redeems the code (linked=true). Until then the Invite button remains (which is the correct/intended supervised-minor flow — personnel invites, minor redeems, guardian approves). If the reviewer really wants immediate switch visibility, the frontend would need to show the switch (disabled) as soon as invite_code exists.

action_items: No blocking issues. Feature is ready.

Optional UX: if desired, show the approve Switch (disabled) as soon as invite_code exists, alongside a 'code sent, waiting for athlete to redeem' status — currently it stays as an Invite button until linked.

Optional: 429 rate-limit responses were observed under rapid navigation in the browser (likely from useFocusEffect double-calls); consider debouncing or caching the athlete list on chat-access screen.
critical_code_review_comments: team_chat.py _is_minor default returns True when DOB unknown (safer default — good).
athlete_chat_links links use unique (household_id, roster_id) pair — invite refresh is idempotent (good).
require_chat_access correctly gates GET/POST /team/chat/messages for non-approved athletes with 403.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing applereview seed (3 athletes: Ava Smith, Bella Jones, Cara Lee). During pytest run, ephemeral test accounts with uuid tags are created and left behind (owner_<tag>@t.com, ava_<tag>@t.com, mom_<tag>@t.com, dad2_<tag>@t.com). Also, Ava's roster row now carries invite_code=3N3DW7 (from UI invite click during this run) — safe to ignore; can be cleared by tapping Invite again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testIDs are login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. Chat header manage-icon testID: chat-manage-access (only shown when NOT supervised). Chat-access screen testIDs: chat-access-screen (root), chat-athlete-<roster_id>, chat-invite-<roster_id>, chat-approve-<roster_id> (Switch — only when linked=true). Supervised banner testID: chat-supervised-banner. Team-locked screen minor button testID: athlete-open-chat. The API surface is documented in /app/backend/routers/team_chat.py; test_team_chat_phase2.py is the definitive backend regression test.
